name: Radio sniffer (Wi-Fi monitor or BLE)
description: A sniffer for Wireshark: a Wi-Fi adapter in monitor mode on one channel, or a Bluetooth LE sniffer dongle (as Nordic's nRF Sniffer) on one advertising channel. It takes every frame it hears, whoever it is for, with its FCS or CRC; the workbench's Air panel lists them and saves them as a pcap file.

radio.doc: A Wi-Fi adapter in monitor mode or a Bluetooth LE sniffer

channel.doc: Wi-Fi: the channel, 1 to 14; BLE: the advertising channel, 37, 38 or 39

snaplen.doc: The bytes of each frame it keeps, as tcpdump's -s

outputs.name: capture
outputs.doc: The last 64 frames, one a line: its number, the time it ended (ps), w or b, the MHz, the RSSI (dBm), its length and its first snaplen bytes in hex

functional.claims: Every 802.11 frame on its Wi-Fi channel or every BLE packet on its advertising channel it hears above the sensitivity (engine/air.h), whoever it is for: an 802.11 frame with its FCS (CRC-32, IEEE 802.11-2020 9.2.4.8), a BLE packet as the link layer has it, the advertising access address, the PDU and its CRC-24 from 0x555555 (Bluetooth Core 5.4 Vol 6 Part B 3.1.1); the time each ended, its frequency and RSSI; the first snaplen bytes and the whole length, as tcpdump keeps them.
omissions: ACKs and other control responses (the air carries them implicitly, not as frames)
following a BLE connection onto the data channels after a CONNECT_IND

electrical.claims: As functional: it has no pins.

sources.title: IEEE Std 802.11-2020: scanning (11.1.4), the beacon and probe frames (9.3.3), the RSN element (9.4.2.24)
sources.notes: Active and passive scanning, the probe request and response, the capability information's Privacy bit, the RSN element's AKM suites.

sources.title: Bluetooth Core Specification 5.4, Vol 6 Part B: the Link Layer (the packet format, the CRC)
sources.notes: The advertising access address 0x8E89BED6, the CRC-24 (polynomial 0x00065B, from 0x555555 on the advertising channels).

sources.title: tcpdump.org: link-layer header types (LINKTYPE_IEEE802_11_RADIOTAP 127, LINKTYPE_BLUETOOTH_LE_LL_WITH_PHDR 256)
sources.notes: The pcap formats the workbench saves the capture in.
